description: Return a list of project stages for a company.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID used to establish project context for authorization.

id.description: Unique identifier for this project stage.

name.description: Display name of the project stage.

is_bidding_stage.description: Whether this stage is a bidding stage.

is_concept_stage.description: Whether this stage is a concept stage.

category.description: Parent Procore category for this company stage.

readonly.description: Whether this is a built-in Procore category stage.

default_stage.description: Whether this is a global default stage that cannot be edited or deleted.

hideable.description: Whether this stage can be hidden from a company.

has_rfi_prefixes.description: Whether any RFI headers in the company use this stage.

project_stage_has_children.description: Whether this stage has child stages under the company.
